late_final_and_duplicates.description: Delivery order includes a final during drain, duplicate retries, an old partial retry, a foreign session, and a callback after completion. The logger preserves transcript revisions once each; interpretation/counting must use the final once.

limitations: A transcript was captured, but there were no delivery measurements or audience changes to explain.
